description_en: Triggers the execution of a stack
kebab_example: aliyun iacservice trigger-stack-execution --client-token a65451293e64979ba7a4b573950217fe --action terraform_plan --changed-folders iac-stack/ --code-version-id v1 --source-trigger-id example-string --code-package-path iacservice::mod-xxx --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TriggerStackExecution

parameters.help_en:
The execution action. Valid values:
terraform plan
terraform apply
state detect
[_single.params.body.props.action.enum.terraform plan]Terraform preview.
[_single.params.body.props.action.enum.terraform apply]Terraform execution.
[_single.params.body.props.action.enum.state detect]State detection
parameters.help_zh:
执行操作
terraform plan
terraform apply
state detect
parameters.name: action

parameters.help_en: The collection of changed files. You can specify only the directory of the changed files
parameters.help_zh: 变更文件集合，可以只指定变更文件目录
parameters.name: changed_folders

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Format: [0-9a-zA-Z-]{1,64}. Use a UUID
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The stack code path. Currently, only stacks created by using infrastructure as code (IaC) templates are supported. Parameter format: iacservice::{moduleId}
parameters.help_zh:
Stack代码路径，当前只支持通过IaC模板创建的Stack，
参数格式：iacservice::{moduleId}
parameters.name: code_package_path

parameters.help_en: The code version that triggers the stack
parameters.name: code_version_id

parameters.help_en: The trigger ID of the source plan. This parameter can be specified only for terraform apply. This parameter is required when confirming a plan generated by terraform destroy
parameters.help_zh: 来源Plan的Trigger ID。仅terraform apply可传；确认terraform destroy生成的Plan时必须传
parameters.name: source_trigger_id

triggerId.description_en: The unique ID of the trigger
